MAC-PORT-YIELD-WITHIN-API.name: portYIELD_WITHIN_API

MAC-LIST-HEAD-OWNER.name: listGET_OWNER_OF_HEAD_ENTRY
MAC-LIST-HEAD-OWNER.active_effect: read the owner of sentinel-next, or NULL for an empty list

MAC-LIST-NEXT-OWNER.name: listGET_OWNER_OF_NEXT_ENTRY
MAC-LIST-NEXT-OWNER.active_effect: advance pxIndex past the sentinel and return the selected owner

MAC-ADD-READY.name: prvAddTaskToReadyQueue
MAC-ADD-READY.active_effect: insert a TCB generic item at the end of its priority ready list

MAC-CHECK-DELAYED.name: prvCheckDelayedTasks
MAC-CHECK-DELAYED.active_effect: remove every expired delayed item and append its TCB to a ready list

list_insert_end_abs.meaning: insert after the cursor and move the cursor to the inserted item

list_insert_ordered_abs.meaning: stable nondecreasing insertion from the sentinel view

list_remove_abs.meaning: remove one item and repair the cursor with its predecessor

task_delay_until_abs.meaning: pure quiescent endpoint model for periodic delay at the nominal wake time

task_delay_abs.meaning: pure quiescent endpoint model for relative task delay

task_increment_tick_abs.meaning: pure tick endpoint model including delayed-role swap on wrap

task_switch_context_abs.meaning: pure priority selection and cursor-relative round-robin endpoint model

task_get_tick_abs.meaning: pure tick query returning the current tick without changing state

xlist_wf.meaning: ring identifiers are distinct and an item cursor belongs to the ring

ordered_keys.meaning: the sentinel-view item-key sequence is nondecreasing

core_wf.meaning: conjunction of scheduler ring shape, delayed-role, membership, time, ready-cache, and current-task invariants

settled_wf.meaning: core scheduler invariant strengthened with no pending-ready or missed-tick debt at an API boundary
